column3: Worship (Shaman only) to gain permanent knowledge: a new spell or building plan that carries to future maps.
Shaman or Braves worship it to generate charges of a specific spell. Sinks into the ground when its charges are used up.
Shaman only. When fully worshipped the segments spin 90 degrees and trigger a world event or unique reward.
Rare Stone Head shaped like an Angel of Death. Only the Shaman can charge it; followers go through the animation. Grants a game-winning effect.
